test.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_daily_evidence_bundle.py tests/test_eod_paper_archive.py; ruff check src/financial_brain/forward_edge/daily_evidence_bundle.py tests/test_daily_evidence_bundle.py src/financial_brain/forward_edge/eod_paper_archive.py

implemented: Portable bundles export account close archive and durable runner journal plus optional evidence inputs with SHA-256 and byte lengths.
Human-readable report derives exclusively from exported inputs and contains no profitability/live-execution overclaim.
Independent verifier checks archive hash, journal hash chain, manifest, input hashes, file set, optional Ed25519 signature, and deterministic report reproduction.
Cross-workstation copy test reproduces identical report bytes and validates with a pinned trusted public-key hash.
Tampering, undeclared files, symbolic links, mismatched trusted keys, and output reuse with another signing key are refused.
blockers: Daily launcher does not yet invoke bundle creation after every completed paper session.
Production signing-key custody and trusted public-key distribution are owner responsibilities and are not configured.
Bundle transfer has no managed delivery channel; this implementation exports a self-contained directory.
